title: Clements/Quotes
summary:
"I don't think it's one of the Legendary Titans, if that's what you mean. I'm guessing it's just an ordinary cursed ring."
- Clements to Zhalia Moon, about the Ring of Arc (Divide and Conquer)

"The Ring of Arc doesn't give, it only takes."
- Clements to Lok Lambert, (The Legendary Titan of Fate)
